references.text: The rumor about Jesus spread throughout all Syria, a parallel to how the report about him spread to the whole surrounding region in Luke 4:37.
The news of Jesus' miracles spread throughout that entire area, reflecting the same dissemination of his reputation as in Luke 4:37.
Mark's parallel account of the event in the synagogue at Capernaum: the report about Jesus immediately spread everywhere throughout the whole region around Galilee.
Earlier in the same chapter it is described how the rumor about Jesus spread over all the surrounding area, forming a frame around the narrative together with verse 37.
Here too the report about Jesus spreads further so that large crowds gather to hear him and be healed, continuing the growing reputation from 4:37.
After raising the widow's son at Nain, this word about him spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding country, parallel to the spreading of the rumor in 4:37.
